text: Keating Chevrolet, the branding on the doors of TF Sport's 2026 #33 Corvette, is the Texas-based dealership group of TF Sport driver Ben Keating, who is the principal owner of the Keating Auto Group.
short: Keating Chevrolet is TF Sport driver Ben Keating's Texas dealership group.

source.name: CorvetteBlogger: [PICS] TF Sport Unveils the 2026 Liveries for its Corvette Z06 GT3.R Racers
source.quote: On the doors are Keating Chevrolet, a nod to driver Ben Keating's Texas-based dealership group.

additionalSources.name: Digital Dealer: Interview With Ben Keating of Keating Auto Group
additionalSources.quote: Today, Ben is the principal owner and chief visionary of the Keating Auto Group, a family-owned company that currently includes 17 popular automobile dealerships across Texas
